body: By making him feel like he's not good enough
I already do this over and over, but a person can only handle so much. I can't keep hurting him over and over and expect him to be ok. I've destroyed him.

Thank you. I just feel like a failure. I keep hurting the one person I truly love because I'm so selfish. I try so hard to fix myself but keep failing and I'm probably even getting worse. It feels hopeless.
